exposure: VBAC vs. elective repeat cesarean section (ERCS)
cohort: Women with a previous low-segment cesarean section, singleton pregnancy, and cephalic presentation who desired a vaginal trial delivery
finding: Bishop's score and spontaneous labor were independent predictors of successful VBAC, and women who achieved VBAC had less postpartum hemorrhage, lower puerperal infection rates, and shorter postpartum hospitalization compared to those with failed TOLAC or ERCS.
